title: Servant Leadership
definition: Servant leadership is Christlike leadership that uses authority to serve, strengthen, protect, and build up others rather than to exalt self.
summary: Servant leadership follows the pattern of Jesus, who came not to be served but to serve.
christFocus: Jesus is the perfect servant Leader, humbling Himself to save His people and teaching His followers to lead through service.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Servant leadership is leadership shaped by the character and mission of Christ. It rejects pride, domination, manipulation, and self-promotion. It uses responsibility to bless and build up others.

Jesus redefined greatness through service. He washed His disciples' feet and gave His life as a ransom for many. Christian leadership must follow that pattern.

Servant leadership does not mean weakness or lack of conviction. It means strength submitted to God, truth spoken in love, and authority used for the good of others.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People have often seen leadership abused. Servant leadership matters because it shows that Christlike authority protects, serves, and strengthens rather than exploits or controls.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Lead where God has placed you by serving faithfully. Ask whether your influence points people to Christ, protects the vulnerable, speaks truth, and seeks the good of others rather than your own recognition.
